exploratory_protocol_specification.protocol_title: Guardian Alpha V30 Exploratory Prospective Research Protocol
exploratory_protocol_specification.scientific_mandate: Non-confirmatory prospective observational evaluation of frozen strategy candidates E0 and D2. Strictly prohibits unearned confirmatory statistical superiority claims or live strategy promotion based on uncalibrated p-values.
exploratory_protocol_specification.research_objective: Quantify real-world prospective downside protection, tracking differences, cash drag, and execution fidelity between frozen E0 and D2 across future market regimes without modifying strategy parameters or optimizing historical rules.

E0_baseline.strategy_type: Momentum Sector Rotation (100% equity across all regimes)

D2_candidate.strategy_type: Defensive Cash Cushion (50% defensive basket XLP/XLU/XLV, 50% cash during risk-off regimes)

causal_eligibility_and_information_bound.decision_timing: Executed strictly on Date T-1 Close data (available after 16:00:00 ET); orders placed in pending queue.
causal_eligibility_and_information_bound.execution_timing: Orders executed at Session T Open (09:30:00 ET) via open_on(ticker, date).
causal_eligibility_and_information_bound.evaluated_holding_period: Session T (marked to market at Session T Close).
causal_eligibility_and_information_bound.collider_bias_prohibition: Conditioning causal eligibility on same-day negative market returns (R_{m,T} < 0) is strictly barred from the primary protocol to eliminate post-treatment collider conditioning.

primary_descriptive_metric.formula: d_t = max(0, -R_{E0,t}) - max(0, -R_{D2,t}) for t where I_{def,t}^{causal} == 1
primary_descriptive_metric.role: Descriptive paired downside shortfall difference. Positive values indicate D2 reduced downside loss relative to E0.

secondary_outcomes: Cumulative total return: R_{E0,cum} and R_{D2,cum} over full horizon
CAGR difference: Delta CAGR = CAGR(D2) - CAGR(E0)
Maximum Peak-to-Trough Drawdown (MDD) for E0 and D2
Annualized Realized Volatility: sigma(E0) and sigma(D2)
Realized Exposure: mean invested equity weight over time
Cash-drag decomposition: performance drag during risk-off sessions where market rallies
Turnover & Transaction Costs: trade frequency, gross turnover, modeled 5 bps slippage
metrics_framework.uncertainty_reporting_policy: All standard errors and confidence intervals (e.g. Wilson score, stationary bootstrap distributions) are reported strictly as descriptive indicators of sample spread, NEVER as confirmatory hypothesis test proofs.

economic_hurdle_10bps.clarification: The 10-bps daily economic hurdle remains an unratified historical proposal; it serves only as an illustrative benchmark in exploratory reports.

cagr_guardrail_200bps.clarification: The -200 bps Delta CAGR guardrail is an unapproved risk suggestion, not an operational veto rule.

evaluation_horizon_252_sessions.clarification: The 252-session horizon is an unapproved planning budget.

maximum_horizon_504_sessions.clarification: The 504-session administrative ceiling is an unapproved planning ceiling.

operational_policies.observation_timestamps: Log exchange bar timestamp, local receive timestamp, decide() execution duration, and order fill timestamp.
operational_policies.missing_data_policy: If bar data is missing for <= 2 bars, hold prior positions; if missing >= 3 bars, trigger automated state quarantine and flag session as MISSING_DATA.
operational_policies.corporate_action_handling: Stock splits adjust historical pricing; cash dividends credit account cash balance without auto-reinvestment.
operational_policies.slippage_accounting: Model 5 bps (0.0005) slippage for standard equity ETFs; 10 bps (0.0010) for leveraged ETFs.
operational_policies.safety_stops: Automated circuit breaker trips if single-day slippage > 50 bps, 3 missing bars, or weight drift > 2%; logged as INFORMATIVE_CENSORING.
operational_policies.stopping_rules: Zero interim optional stopping. No early termination upon favorable interim outcomes. No retrospective parameter tuning.

tripartite_governance_separation.observation: Transparent, lossless recording of daily market prices, order fills, cash balances, and regime states.
tripartite_governance_separation.inference: Descriptive statistical summarization of observed sample distributions and empirical confidence bands.
tripartite_governance_separation.strategy_promotion: Confirmatory deployment to live capital. STRICTLY PROHIBITED under this exploratory protocol. Reusing the Stage 3B-R2 joint HAC/bootstrap rule (which failed nominal size calibration at 7.7% - 10.8% rejection) as a promotional gate is prohibited.
